zones.title: Show Flexom Zones
zones.description: Flexom Zones (i.e. rooms) will appear as devices with light and rolling shutter controls.

separateAccessories.title: Separate light and shutter accessories
separateAccessories.description: Expose each zone's light and each of its window coverings as separate HomeKit accessories (e.g. "Lounge Light", "Lounge Shutter 1", "Lounge Shutter 2"), each with its own name and room. When disabled, they are grouped in a single accessory per zone. Switching re-creates the window covering accessories in HomeKit (lights are kept).

tolerance.title: Factor value tolerance
tolerance.description: How far (ratio between 0 and 1) a window covering can stop from its target and still be considered there, as Flexom devices do not always reach the exact requested value (e.g. 0.01 instead of 0 when closed). HomeKit then shows the requested position. Also used to ignore small position jitter.

refreshInterval.title: State refresh interval (seconds)
refreshInterval.description: How often to fetch every zone's state from Flexom, to fix HomeKit when a change was missed (e.g. a light switched on with a wall switch but not reported). Default 900 (15 minutes). Zones are refreshed one at a time across the interval, so short intervals mean frequent API requests (one per second with 10 zones at 10 seconds). Set to 0 to disable.
